originalTitle: Please stop asking me when the AI bubble will pop

content: People, including on this staff, keep asking me with varying degrees of excitement or trepidation when the AI bubble will burst. I’ll tell you what I tell them: If I knew that, I would make a life-changing bet on the market, levered up as far as I could, and then, after I made my money, go retire on a beach somewhere. Maybe run a cat sanctuary, who knows. What I can tell you is that I read with interest a story in Bloomberg this morning: “Wall Street CEOs, Big Money Managers Divided Over AI Risks.” The story itself is a roundup of stuff said at the 2026 Global Financial Leaders’ Investment Summit in Hong Kong. Here’s what caught my attention: The CEO of Pacific Investment Management Co. — that’s PIMCO, the legendary bond firm — told listeners that there’s going to be a downturn in the AI market “and then things are going to break.” The astronomically expensive AI buildout has swamped debt markets — making it harder to raise cash. But there’s still more debt coming, and people still want to buy it. For instance, Meta drew $58 billion in orders for a bond offering that’s expected to be $15 billion to $20 billion, Bloomberg reported today. Oracle said Monday it would need another $20 billion in bonds, on top of its existing steep commitments. Alphabet, Google’s parent company, is selling €6 billion (or about $6.7 billion) of bonds. Even Microsoft recently sold bonds, for the first time in a decade — $25 billion of them. The PIMCO CEO — his name is Emmanuel Roman, but his job is what matters here — has estimated that the AI buildout could create $2 trillion in financing needs over the next five years. The entire total US bond market is about $12 trillion. I am harping on PIMCO because it has been instrumental in the AI trade. It was among the group of financiers that did the first CoreWeave chip-based financing in 2023. It made a quick $2 billion in paper gains from $29 billion in Meta bonds, meant to support the AI buildout, last year. It bought $4 billion of SpaceX bonds last month. If PIMCO’s CEO is publicly sounding the alarm about a bubble popping, that’s a big deal — especially since the company just sold a bunch of its AI debt. It’s not just PIMCO urging caution. Apollo Global Management, which lately had been talking with SpaceX about a $40 billion chip deal, is also warning of AI risk. Apollo president Jim Zelter told analysts today that while he expects society will use “dramatically more computing power in the future” and that AI is improving quickly, there is still significant uncertainty. “What we don’t know is how pricing and economics will evolve.” The sheer volume of interest on Meta’s bonds suggests we are not at the top of the market. But there have been reports from China that its AI bubble burst some time ago. Meanwhile Wall Street banks were tripping over themselves to finance $63 billion in debt from Anthropic — not even a hyperscaler. This is what I mean when I say “I don’t know.” I do think, though, that something major — PIMCO’s Roman singled out US rate hikes, war, or a eurozone crisis as potential triggers — could flip this market. We’re not in go-go-go territory now. Maybe that will change; it’s possible Anthropic’s IPO will go blockbuster and it’ll be like when someone rolls up to a party that’s running low on beer with a 24-pack. But as more people are expressing caution — and particularly after the disaster at Situational Awareness — the best part of the party might be over.
chineseTitle: 请不要再问我 AI 泡沫何时破灭
chineseSummary: 人们，包括这里的员工，不断以不同程度的兴奋或恐惧问我人工智能泡沫何时会破裂。我会告诉你我告诉他们的话：如果我知道这一点，我会在市场上进行改变生活的赌注，尽可能提高杠杆率，然后，在我赚到钱后，[...]
chineseContent: 人们，包括这里的员工，不断以不同程度的兴奋或恐惧问我人工智能泡沫何时会破裂。我会告诉你我告诉他们的话：如果我知道这一点，我会在市场上进行改变生活的赌注，尽可能提高杠杆率，然后，在我赚到钱后，去某个海滩退休。也许经营一个猫庇护所，谁知道呢。我可以告诉你的是，我今天早上饶有兴趣地读到了彭博社的一篇报道：“华尔街首席执行官、大资金经理对人工智能风险存在分歧。”这个故事本身是在香港举行的 2026 年全球金融领袖投资峰会上所说的内容的摘要。以下是引起我注意的事情：太平洋投资管理公司（太平洋投资管理公司，即太平洋投资管理公司，一家传奇的债券公司）的首席执行官告诉听众，人工智能市场将会出现低迷，“然后事情就会崩溃”。天文数字般昂贵的人工智能建设已经淹没了债务市场——使得筹集现金变得更加困难。但还有更多的债务即将到来，人们仍然想购买它。例如，据彭博社今天报道，Meta 筹集了 580 亿美元的债券发行订单，预计金额为 150 亿至 200 亿美元。甲骨文周一表示，除了现有的巨额承诺之外，还需要另外 200 亿美元的债券。谷歌母公司 Alphabet 正在出售 60 亿欧元（约合 67 亿美元）的债券。就连微软最近也出售了 250 亿美元的债券，这是十年来的首次。 PIMCO 首席执行官——他的名字是 Emmanuel Roman，但他的工作才是最重要的——估计人工智能的建设可能在未来五年内创造 2 万亿美元的融资需求。整个美国债券市场总额约为12万亿美元。我之所以喋喋不休地谈论太平洋投资管理公司，是因为它在人工智能行业中发挥了重要作用。它属于金融集团之一
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
